address: 22 Mu 5, Ban Ko, Bang Sai, Phra Nakhon Si Ayutthaya, 13190, Thailand
bio: Set beside a peaceful canal, the crowds flock here for their speciality: beef noodles. The noodles come with offal, beef balls, spare ribs and tender beef slices. The soup is also superb, with a meaty aroma. It’s so popular, the chef prepares 25-30 kg of fresh offal every day....
